ranking_basis: Expected value of information per implementation cost; qualitative only; no numerical DTI gain assumed.
prior_art_boundary: This checkout initially contained only README.md. Prior campaign pages were reviewed as owner-reported evidence, not independently verified score provenance. Novelty claims are limited to this checkout and the reviewed links.

hypotheses.title: Conflict-aware evidence fusion of dotted and tip/step-over structures
hypotheses.physical_signature: Pixelwise support for fault-compatible structure from two distinct generation rules; retain lower belief and report raw conflict where one family supports and the other does not.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: The two families nominate candidate faults using different construction rules; disagreement is retained for expert review rather than treated as proof of absence.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: No fusion implementation in this checkout; not globally novel. Distinct from arithmetic mean and the reported GEMSDOE2 dual-family union.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Unknown; no positive numeric delta assumed.
hypotheses.data_status: Two public owner mirrors retrieved and SHA-256 verified; neither organizer-authenticated.
hypotheses.gate: Compare fusion, each input and arithmetic mean on four fixed spatial blocks using official DTI; an improvement over stronger input on >=3/4 blocks is necessary, but leakage-free source rebuild is also required before any slot is cleared.

hypotheses.title: Stratigraphic-contact termination / offset detector
layers: USGS GeMS version of SGMC geologic-unit polygons and contacts
hypotheses.physical_signature: Contact graph terminations, kinks or juxtaposition coincident with geophysical breaks.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Unmapped or buried faulting may truncate/juxtapose geologic units without a Quaternary fault trace in the catalogue.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Uses topology of unit-contact discontinuities, not SGMC fault lines as predictions and not a raw edge-ridge detector.
hypotheses.data_status: Official USGS DOI 10.5066/P1A3DQZK is listed; metadata checked, payload and target-scale coverage not audited.

hypotheses.title: OPERA InSAR line-of-sight displacement-gradient discontinuities
layers: NASA/JPL OPERA DISP-S1 LOS time series
hypotheses.physical_signature: Persistent temporal LOS velocity/change-point gradient across a narrow, coherent boundary.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Active or creeping faults can deform without a mapped surface scarp; this does not detect locked/inactive faults and is not fault truth.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Time-dependent 30 m interferometric deformation, unlike static 100 m geophysical/terrain predictors or event-density summaries.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Low-moderate public DTI; potentially useful final-round review evidence.
hypotheses.data_status: Official free NASA catalog product with North American coverage; Earthdata Login required to download. Metadata checked; no granules/coverage counts downloaded.

hypotheses.title: 3D hydrography knickpoint / channel-offset test
layers: USGS NHDPlus HR or 3DHP channel network
hypotheses.physical_signature: Paired longitudinal-profile breaks and laterally deflected channels aligned to a structural trend.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Fault displacement can alter channels where fault scarps are subtle or eroded; multiple-channel coherence can reject isolated erosional noise.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Targets channel profile discontinuities/paired responses, not valley-lineament continuity or scarp amplitude.
hypotheses.data_status: Official USGS NHDPlus HR/map-service and free 3DEP product pages checked; exact footprint coverage still needs audit.

hypotheses.title: High geothermal favorability plus ensemble spread as a structural search prior
layers: USGS Great Basin favorability percentiles P05/P25/P50/P75/P95 from 1,200 model realizations
hypotheses.physical_signature: High published median favorability and high between-realization spread outside/away from catalogue traces.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: May identify geothermal pathways not represented by mapped faults; favorability is not fault truth and requires separate fault validation.
hypotheses.difference_from_prior: Uses uncertainty from an independent published regional model output rather than reweighting the same raw GeoDAWN layers.
hypotheses.expected_dti: Unknown; probably low-moderate for public fault DTI.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; official package listed at about 1.22 GB.
hypotheses.data_status: Official USGS release DOI 10.5066/P14EET2C, CC0 1.0; .gov page checked, package not downloaded.

validation_protocol.spatial_folds: Four fixed geographic quadrants on the 3292 x 3730 EPSG:32611 100 m grid, with a 300 m evaluation halo; holdout label raster used only as catalogue-proxy truth.
validation_protocol.promotion_rule: No slot promotion without positive paired mean and >=3/4 positive folds versus each individual input, plus fold-independent source rebuild. A proxy pass alone is not a competition score.
known_risks: Source TIF construction used catalogue information or prior model artifacts; a frozen-surface blocked score can be conditional/leaky.
Sparse raster zeros may mean no emission rather than evidence of no fault.
The two source rasters may share a common backbone and are not assumed statistically independent.
